hey, here is how i will explain how 🎰Poulet's Gacha Pull🎰 actually work:

What does my script do?
1.it assigns a rarity when you run the command  : /pull
2. make so the rarity affects the character creation (make it so a B character is less cool than an S tier)
3. It writes back information in this format:
Name:
Gender:
Age:
Physical Appearance: (max 2–3 sentences, concise)
Personality: (max 2–3 traits, no prose)
Rarity: rarity

So, what does this script do? 
-bring a simple gacha mechanic (ready to copy and paste in a story card)
-a rarity system
-personalised rarity odds
-Allow different description personalization based on rarities.

What does this script not do?
-Work by itself, the AI will need a custom context in your AI instruction, plot essentials and author's notes.

for example let's say you want to summon a character on the daily banner of your game :
do -> /pull on the daily banner (the ai will get the context of the story and your input do give you a character sheet 1-2 turns after)

but i'll recomend to be more precise : 
do -> / pull on the Cyberpunk girl Banner (by giving context, gender and theme, the Ai will Give a better answer)

title: pullconfig
description:
here you can change the gacha sheet format.
(when you change the format, it make take some retries!)

-if your format is working, you will see: ✅ custom Format loaded
(it will load the custom format in this story card)

-if not : ⛓️‍💥default format loaded
(it will load a basic format)

here's some examples:

---exemple 1---
state.customFormat = `
Type: spaceship
Name:
manufacturer:
condition:
Appearance:
Personality:
Rarity:`;

state.customInstructions = "make a 750 maximum letters description.";

---exemple 2---
state.customFormat = `
Type: fakemon
Name:
type:
LVL:
Appearance:
Personality:
Rarity:`;

state.customInstructions = "make a minimum 750 letters description, Create your own original Fakemon (fake pokemon).";
